profiles_select_propria_ou_equipe.name: profiles_select_propria_ou_equipe
profiles_select_propria_ou_equipe.using:
"profiles"."id" = (select auth.uid())
        or exists (
          select 1
          from wedding_members eu
          join wedding_members outra on outra.wedding_id = eu.wedding_id
          where eu.user_id = (select auth.uid())
            and eu.convite_aceito_em is not null
            and outra.user_id = "profiles"."id"
            and outra.convite_aceito_em is not null
        )

gifts_publico_select.name: gifts_publico_select
gifts_publico_select.using: exists (select 1 from weddings w where w.id = "gifts"."wedding_id" and w.publicado = true)

gifts_publico_reservar.name: gifts_publico_reservar
gifts_publico_reservar.using:
reservado_por_email is null
        and exists (select 1 from weddings w where w.id = "gifts"."wedding_id" and w.publicado = true)
gifts_publico_reservar.withCheck: exists (select 1 from weddings w where w.id = "gifts"."wedding_id" and w.publicado = true)
